issue.title: Key  IPV6_NEXT_HEADER is not supported in MIRRORV6 ACL

failure.body:
**Description**
Key  **IPV6_NEXT_HEADER** is not supported in MIRRORV6 ACL.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Create ACL table by applying json file:
```
{
    "ACL_TABLE": {
        "EVERFLOWV6": {
            "policy_desc": "EVERFLOWV6",
            "ports": [
                "Ethernet0",
                "Ethernet4",
                "Ethernet8",
                "Ethernet12",
                "Ethernet16",
                "Ethernet20",
                "Ethernet24",
                "Ethernet28",
                "Ethernet32",
                "Ethernet36",
                "Ethernet40",
                "Ethernet44",
                "Ethernet48",
                "Ethernet52",
                "Ethernet56",
                "Ethernet60",
                "Ethernet64"
            ],
            "type": "MIRRORV6",
            "stage": "ingress"
        }
      }
}
```
2. Create a mirror session by applying json file:
```
{
    "MIRROR_SESSION": {
        "session1": {
            "dst_ip": "<IP>",
            "gre_type": "0x8949",
            "src_ip": "<IP>",
            "ttl": "10"
        }
    }
}
```
3. Create ACL rule by applying json file
```
{
    "ACL_RULE": {
        "EVERFLOWV6|RULE_1": {
            "PRIORITY": "9999",
            "MIRROR_INGRESS_ACTION": "session1",
            "IPV6_NEXT_HEADER": "17",
            "L4_SRC_PORT": "2002",
            "L4_DST_PORT": "2222",
            "SRC_IPv6": "2001::1/64",
            "DST_IPv6": "3000::1/64"
        }
    }
}
```

**Describe the results you received:**
Applying aforementioned rule causes errors:
```
May 10 <IPV6>.693177 auto ERR swss#orchagent: :- doAclRuleTask: Unknown or invalid rule attribute 'IPV6_NEXT_HEADER : 17'
May 10 <IPV6>.693177 auto ERR swss#orchagent: :- doAclRuleTask: Failed to create ACL rule. Rule configuration is invalid
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
The key **IPV6_NEXT_HEADER** should be supported for specifying next header following ipv6 header.

resolution.title: [acl] Replace IP_PROTOCOL with NEXT_HEADER for IPv6 ACL tables
resolution.description:
- Update qualifiers for all platforms
- Fix C++ unit tests
- Add new VS test cases

Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <<EMAIL>>

**What I did**
I updated aclorch to use NEXT_HEADER rather than IP_PROTOCOL for all IPv6 ACL tables.

The 202012 release will still allow users to specify IP_PROTOCOL in config DB, but it will use the new SAI attributes under the hood and print a deprecation warning to the logs.

**Why I did it**
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/4570
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/issues/1316

**How I verified it**
Added new test cases and updated the old VS/C++ unit test cases. Change looks good on physical devices as well.

**Details if related**
